title: A battle near Pune decided the fate of an empire that had ruled for over a century.
caption:
A battle near Pune decided the fate of an empire that had ruled for over a century.

East India Company forces defeated the army of Peshwa Baji Rao II in a decisive early battle of the Third Anglo-Maratha War.

It marked the effective end of over a century of Maratha Empire rule in the region - one of the pivotal military turning points of early 19th-century Indian history.

Khadki is a reminder that the map of modern India was shaped by battles, treaties and negotiations long before 1947 - history worth knowing on its own terms.
